additional_info.subject: Intervention 24/04/2025
additional_info.body:
Report on the on-site intervention conducted with Simon and I.
Upon arrival, we observed that the charger was not connected to the SCB, and the screen displayed "Hello/Hallo." We decided to use a Live Linux environment to restore the configuration. However, when the script prompted us to insert the Cfast card, it did not recognize the card after insertion.
We then attempted to flash the Cfast card with version 6.0.3, but the issue persisted. Using another Cfast card did not resolve the problem either. Consequently, we decided to bypass the key and create a new ID by inserting a flashed Cfast card and changing the router settings to admin01.
After reparameter the charger. and did testing with Simon on CCS. Charger is online and charging session sucessfull
No further action needed
